# vendor

Self-hosted copies of GSAP 3.15.0 (`gsap` and `ScrollTrigger`), from the official `gsap` npm package.
Licence: GSAP "Standard no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license

The version is in each filename so the files can be cached for a year. To upgrade, add the new files,
point the two `<script>` tags in `index.html` at them, and delete the old ones.
